ranged_attack.name: Ice Shard
ranged_attack.windup: plants her feet and levels her staff at {target} with both hands, three long ice shards forming around its crystal and glowing cold blue
ranged_attack.release: sweeps the staff forward and the three shards shoot out as bright blue-white streaks of light
ranged_attack.travel: the glowing shards fly point-first across the courtyard, each trailing a thin line of glittering frost
ranged_attack.impact: they shatter against {target} in a sharp icy-blue flash and a spray of sparkling white ice crystals
ranged_attack.decay: the ice crystals vanish in an instant, leaving {target} clear
ranged_attack.again: levels her staff again and fires three more glowing blue shards that shatter in a bright flash against {target} and vanish at once
ranged_attack.text: levels her ice-crystal staff at {target}, frost swirling around its head, and fires three glowing blue ice shards that shatter in a bright flash on it and vanish at once

melee_attack.name: Frost Staff
melee_attack.windup: steps in and pulls her staff back with both hands, its crystal head flaring cold blue
melee_attack.impact: the glowing crystal head cracks into {target} in a bright blue flash and a burst of white frost
melee_attack.decay: the frost glow fades at once
melee_attack.recover: draws the staff back to her side, her cape settling
melee_attack.again: jabs her glowing staff into {target} again in a bright blue flash that fades at once
melee_attack.text: thrusts her ice-crystal staff into {target} in a bright blue flash of frost that fades at once

dash.name: Frost Glide
dash.text: glides forward low on a trail of glowing blue frost, her cape streaming behind her
